Poe Dameron printable slip from the 4 May 2016 Set 4 preview, with the pale Resistance emblem border.

== Source ==
* Players Committee, [https://web.archive.org/web/20160509045316id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/virtual/Set-4-Preview.pdf#page=1 Set 4 Preview], p. 1, center Poe Dameron slip. The sheet reads “Official text as of May 4, 2016”; captured 9 May 2016.

== File details ==
The publisher’s panel was rendered at 300 dpi and cropped to the slip and its printed margin.
